_comment: Candidate company identifiers for scripts/discover_companies.py to LIVE-VERIFY before promotion into data/discovery_sources.json. A token appearing here is NOT treated as an active source -- discover_jobs.py never reads this file. Each candidate is a real company guessed to run its careers page on the named ATS (board token usually mirrors the company's own slug/domain); scripts/discover_companies.py confirms this with a real HTTP request and only a company whose board actually resolves (HTTP 200 with a parseable job list, even an empty one) is eligible to be added to discovery_sources.json -- a 404/unavailable candidate is dropped and reported, never guessed into the active list. Skewed toward product-led SaaS, fintech, and dev-tool companies (more likely to run Product/Business-Analysis/Project-Program openings) per profile/preferences.md, rather than a blind large-company sweep.
